(a) Since you’re rocking contacts or glasses all day, try the 20-20-20 rule—every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds to give your eyes a timeout. Keep some lubricating drops handy for when the air gets dry, and maybe tweak your screen brightness so it matches the room, just like adjusting camera settings for crisp sports shots.
(b) Since you’re usually streaming live sports with surround sound blasting, try the 20-20-20 rule—every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds to reset. (c) Try the 20-20-20 rule—every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds to help relax your eyes. Keep lubricating eye drops on hand if they start to feel dry, and adjust your screen brightness so it’s comfortable for the lighting in your workspace.

If you’d like to preserve both your laptop and your cat’s sense of closeness, you could place a warm cat bed or soft blanket beside your typical work spot.
